metas.name: 1. Habeas Tortoise
metas.description: After Homer humiliates himself in a town meeting, he looks for acceptance in an internet group hunting for a missing tortoise but finds something much more sinister.

metas.name: 2. One Angry Lisa
metas.description: Lisa gets called for jury duty while Marge becomes obsessed with her exercise bike.

metas.name: 3. Lisa the Boy Scout
metas.description: When the Boy Explorers become co-ed, Bart and Lisa vow to "out scout" each other at the annual jamboree.

metas.name: 4. The King of Nice
metas.description: Marge is hired as a segment producer on Krusty's new daytime talk show. But her initial excitement about the job fades when she discovers what an endless nightmare it is!

metas.name: 5. Not It
metas.description: Homer and his teenaged friends are pursued by a killer clown in a spoof of Stephen King's novel "It".

metas.name: 6. Treehouse of Horror XXXIII
metas.description: In a book-themed trilogy, Marge's resentment takes monstrous form, Lisa tries to save the planet through murder and Homer learns he's not the man he thought he was.

metas.name: 7. From Beer to Paternity
metas.description: When Homer becomes Duffman's girl-dad hero, they go on a road trip with Lisa that threatens to expose Homer's terrible parenting.

metas.name: 8. Step Brother from the Same Planet
metas.description: Homer is stunned by his feelings of rage and resentment when Grampa becomes a doting stepfather to his girlfriend's quirky young son. Lisa and Bart throw the ultimate slumber party.

metas.name: 9. When Nelson Met Lisa
metas.description: A future tale of the will-they-won't-they-I-guess-they-won't-maybe-they-will of Springfield's most unlikely couple.

metas.name: 10. Game Done Changed
metas.description: When Bart discovers a profitable glitch in an online game, he ropes Principal Skinner into his lucrative criminal enterprise. Marge and Maggie discover paradise.

metas.name: 11. Top Goon
metas.description: Coach Moe recruits the world's greatest brawlers to teach Nelson the art of hockey goonery.

metas.name: 12. My Life as a Vlog
metas.description: Through a series of YouTube recommended videos, the story of the rise and fall of The Simpson Family Vlog is revealed.

metas.name: 13. The Many Saints of Springfield
metas.description: When Ned Flanders falls on hard times, Fat Tony makes him an offer he can't refuse.

metas.name: 14. Carl Carlson Rides Again
metas.description: When Carl is smitten by a beautiful woman, he looks into the roots of his own identity by discovering the origins of a mysterious rodeo buckle.

metas.name: 15. Bartless
metas.description: When Bart's latest prank leads to chaos at Springfield Elementary, Marge and Homer dream of a world in which their rambunctious son was never a Simpson.

metas.name: 16. Hostile Kirk Place
metas.description: When Milhouse's Dad, Kirk, takes exception to a school history lesson that paints one of his ancestors in a bad light, Kirk goes on a crusade to censor and control the school curriculum -- a crusade that Homer co-opts for fun and profit.

metas.name: 17. Pin Gal
metas.description: A mysterious figure from Marge's past returns to coach her for a bowling tournament.

metas.name: 18. Fan-ily Feud
metas.description: Homer publicly disparages a pop singer and faces the ire of her vindictive and highly organized fan army.

metas.name: 19. Write Off This Episode
metas.description: When Marge and Lisa start a charity together, Marge is seduced by the money and prestige of Big Charity fundraising.

metas.name: 20. The Very Hungry Caterpillars
metas.description: When a plague of insects shuts down Springfield, the Simpsons face their greatest challenge yet… spending time in lockdown with each other.

metas.name: 21. Clown v. Board of Education
metas.description: Krusty opens a school for clowning, and it becomes the most successful thing he's ever done.

metas.name: 22. Homer's Adventures Through the Windshield Glass
metas.description: Time stands still after Homer crashes his car and flies through the windshield. As his life flashes before his eyes, a magical friend helps Homer learn the secret truth about his marriage.
